title: The Hook: The Tale of Two Friends
text: Imagine two friends, Rohan and Aman. Rohan rarely gets sick, even when everyone in class has a cold. Aman, on the other hand, catches a fever if he even steps out in the rain for a minute. Have you ever wondered why this happens? What is the invisible shield that protects Rohan?

content.title: Socratic Thinking
content.prompt: If you never fall sick, does that mean you are 100% healthy? What if you are always angry or stressed? Take a moment to think: What does 'Health' truly mean?

content.title: Discovery: The Fortress of the Body
content.description: Think of your body as a magnificent fortress. Health is not just about strong walls (physical health), but also about the peace inside the castle (mental health) and good relations with neighboring kingdoms (social health).

title: The Reveal: What is Health?
text: The World Health Organization (WHO) defines Health as a state of complete physical, mental, and social well-being, and not merely the absence of disease or infirmity. The word 'Health' comes from the Old English word 'hælth', meaning 'wholeness'.

content.definition: A state of complete physical, mental, and social well-being.
A disorder of structure or function in a human, animal, or plant, especially one that produces specific signs or symptoms.

content.title: Common Misconception
content.text: Many students think 'Disease-free' and 'Healthy' are the exact same thing. You can be disease-free but still feel tired or depressed (which means you are not fully healthy).

content.question: According to the World Health Organization, what does 'health' mean?
options: A state of complete physical, mental, and social well-being

title: Reflection: Your Own Lifestyle
text: Reflect on your own life. Are you eating nutritious food? Are you happy and calm? Do you have good friends and relationships? Remember, if you are physically fit but always stressed, you are not truly healthy. Which of the three areas (physical, mental, social) do you need to improve?

content.title: Teacher's Tip
content.text: Always remember that mental health is just as important as physical health. If your mind is stressed, your physical immunity drops!

title: Connection: Connecting the Dots
text: Your health is connected to everything you do! Good nutrition fuels your physical health. A healthy environment prevents communicable diseases. The ancient Indian science of Ayurveda also focuses on this balance of mind, body, and spirit.

content.title: Mastery: Design Your Health Plan
content.prompt: Create a simple 1-day plan that includes one activity for physical health (like cycling), one for mental health (like meditation or reading), and one for social health (like playing a team game). You are the architect of your own fortress!
